content_html: New Discovery: Readwise & Reader Daniel Wirtz 2 years ago Copy link readwise.io https://readwise.io/ readwise.io https://readwise.io/read I’ve recently discovered Readwise and Reader, and have become a subscriber after a 30-day trial. Especially the Reader is amazing. It’s probably the single best reading and highlighting experience you can wish for regarding PDFs, ebooks, and web articles. Even YouTube videos are supported. In combination with an iPad, it’s a great – and smarter – replacement for a Kindle.
